acceptanceCriteria: A fixed experimental Boost.Test runner profile is added to docs/specs/test-runner-execution-v0.md § Runner inventory with numbered requirements, a pinned native acquisition (version, source and checksum) and a machine-readable native report reader.
The profile maps each Boost.Test test to a stable identity at the level its native report carries, and a failed, skipped or unreported test produces uncertainty, never a pass.
Maintained tests run a pinned Boost.Test fixture end to end and trace each requirement; live qualification evidence is retained for the C/C++ parent V1-0593.
A build-log entry records the evidence, NOT_RUN limits and rollback, and V1-0642 / decision 0437 is cited.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Decision 0437 (owner-accepted 2026-10-06, answering V1-0642) closes the CEM 1.0 main-framework set and accepts Boost.Test as an addition under V1-0593 (Go, Rust, .NET, C/C++). No Boost.Test profile exists today.

completion.reason: Delivered in batch F, PR beamfall/corvint#688, auto-merged to main 2026-10-08T16:21:32Z as a5527cf4288c6a8ecbe620da661dbd9f04ac96d2. All required hosted CI checks passed on head c766a6e1, including the Linux fixes for the groupreap leader PID race and the tcq fixture read scope. The batch CEM was bound and sealed against batch E head cab26d50 (dogfood check PASS, 131/131 hunks supported) and Codex reviewed each lane and the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-08-boost-test-profile.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-f-integration.md at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256); the build logs record the focused tests and limits. Requirements stay proposed pending owner acceptance where the spec says so. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner preference for scoped work). Live qualification limits stay as the build logs record them.

title: CEM 1.0 runner profile: Boost.Test (decision 0437 accepted addition, under V1-0593)
